general.notes: Primary module OP13LI8-005D: MPO-12 receptacle, 2*DR4 media. OP13LI8-005D-2: MPO-16, DR8. Reach stated as 500m throughout (0.5 km). Power: dissipation <11 W, typical 10W. Data rate 212.5 Gbps per optical channel with PAM4; signaling 106.25 GBd per lane optical. Host must implement FEC for reliable operation; LPO module has no CDR. Transmit OMA per lane min: -0.3 dBm for Max(TECQ, TDECQ)<0.9dB; -1.2+Max(TECQ, TDECQ) dBm for 0.9dB≤Max(TECQ, TDECQ)≤3.4dB. Receiver sensitivity (OMA): -3.4 dBm for TECQ<0.9 dB; -4.3+TECQ dBm for 0.9dB≤TECQ≤SECQ (BER@2.4e-4, PRBS31Q). TDECQ/TECQ/SECQ measured with FFE15 reference equalizer at SER@4.8e-4. Optical receiver damage threshold 5.0 dBm. Storage temperature -40 to 85°C (absolute max, not normal operating).

general.suggestions: Datasheet lists transmission distance column as (km) but cells use 500m; clarify reach unit. No host/media interface ID hex values or explicit FEC type despite FEC being required on host. No OSNR or dispersion/PDL tolerance parameters for this LPO module.
